items_flat.title_en: Over 1,100 AI Lab Staff Petition U.S. Government to Support Tools for Deliberately Pacing Frontier AI
items_flat.title_zh: 超過1,100名AI實驗室員工聯署請願美國政府支持刻意調節前沿AI進度的工具
items_flat.summary_en: More than 1,100 researchers and staff from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta and other labs signed the “Pacing the Frontier” petition calling on the U.S. government to support an international effort to develop technical and governance tools needed to deliberately pace the frontier of automated AI development. OpenAI and Anthropic officially endorsed the statement on X.
items_flat.summary_zh: 來自OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、Meta等實驗室的超過1,100名研究與員工簽署「Pacing the Frontier」請願，呼籲美國政府支持國際合作，開發可刻意調節自動化AI研發前沿進度的技術與治理工具。OpenAI與Anthropic已在X正式表態支持。
items_flat.analysis_en: The petition is notable for cross-lab consensus on the need for optional pacing mechanisms rather than an immediate pause. Whether governments build the requested tools, and how competitive pressures interact with any future coordination, remains the central uncertainty.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此聯署值得注意的是跨實驗室對「可選調節機制」而非立即暫停的共識。政府是否真會建立所求工具，以及競爭壓力與未來協調如何互動，仍是核心不確定性。
items_flat.quote: We request that the U.S. government support an international effort to develop the technical and governance tools needed to deliberately pace the frontier of automated AI development.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們請求美國政府支持一項國際努力，開發必要的技術與治理工具，以便刻意調節自動化AI研發的前沿進度。

items_flat.title_en: xAI Introduces Build Mode for Creating Apps, Games and Dashboards with Grok
items_flat.title_zh: xAI推出Build Mode，可用Grok直接創建App、遊戲與儀表板
items_flat.summary_en: xAI announced Build Mode, now in early beta for SuperGrok Heavy subscribers on web, iOS and Android. Users describe an idea and Grok builds a working website, app, game or interactive dashboard live in the chat, then publishes it to a shareable link or custom domain.
items_flat.summary_zh: xAI宣布Build Mode，目前為SuperGrok Heavy訂閱用戶的早期測試版，支援網頁、iOS與Android。使用者描述想法後，Grok即時在對話中建立可用的網站、App、遊戲或互動儀表板，並可一鍵發布至可分享連結或自訂網域。
items_flat.analysis_en: This further collapses the distance between idea and functional software, keeping the entire creation loop inside Grok’s ecosystem. Real production robustness and long-term maintainability of the generated apps remain to be proven at scale.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此功能進一步縮短「想法到可用軟體」的距離，並將整個創作迴路留在Grok生態系內。生成App的實際生產穩健性與長期可維護性仍有待大規模驗證。
items_flat.quote: Today we're introducing Build Mode, a new way to create with Grok. Tell Grok an idea, and it builds a working version live in your chat... When it's ready, publish it to a link anyone can open.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們推出Build Mode，這是與Grok一起創作的新方式。告訴Grok一個想法，它就會在對話中即時建立可用版本……準備好後，發布到任何人都能打開的連結。

items_flat.title_en: NVIDIA-Led Open Secure AI Alliance Expands with 40+ Partners Including xAI, Microsoft and Hugging Face
items_flat.title_zh: NVIDIA主導的Open Secure AI Alliance擴展至40+合作夥伴，包括xAI、Microsoft與Hugging Face
items_flat.summary_en: NVIDIA’s Open Secure AI Alliance, launched 27 July and further promoted on 28 July, brings together more than 40 organizations (including SpaceXAI/xAI, Microsoft, Hugging Face, Mistral, IBM, Linux Foundation and others) to develop open tools and practices for securing AI models and agents.
items_flat.summary_zh: NVIDIA於7月27日啟動、28日持續推廣的Open Secure AI Alliance，已集結超過40個組織（包括SpaceXAI/xAI、Microsoft、Hugging Face、Mistral、IBM、Linux Foundation等），共同開發保護AI模型與代理的開源工具與實踐。
items_flat.analysis_en: The alliance frames open models and tooling as defensive assets in the wake of recent closed-model sandbox incidents. Its long-term effectiveness will depend on concrete shared artifacts and adoption beyond the founding members.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此聯盟將開源模型與工具定位為近期封閉模型沙箱事件後的防禦性資產。長期成效取決於能否產出具體共享成果並擴大創始成員以外的採用。
items_flat.quote: AI security advances when the industry builds in the open, together.
items_flat.quote_zh: AI安全的進展，來自產業一起公開建構。

links.label: NVIDIA Blog – Open Secure AI Alliance

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic’s Claude Mythos Preview Discovers Cryptographic Weaknesses in HAWK and Reduced-Round AES
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic的Claude Mythos Preview發現HAWK與縮減回合AES的密碼弱點
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic’s Frontier Red Team reported that Claude Mythos Preview found an improved key-recovery attack on HAWK (a NIST post-quantum signature candidate), cutting effective key strength roughly in half (e.g., HAWK-256 from 2^64 to 2^38), and a substantially faster attack on a reduced-round version of AES.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic Frontier Red Team報告，Claude Mythos Preview發現對HAWK（NIST後量子簽名候選方案）的改進密鑰恢復攻擊，將有效密鑰強度大約減半（例如HAWK-256從2^64降至2^38），並對縮減回合的AES找到速度大幅提升的攻擊。
items_flat.analysis_en: The results demonstrate that frontier models can already perform expert-level cryptanalysis that previously required human specialists and years of review. They strengthen the case for continuous, automated red-teaming of cryptographic standards while underscoring that the concrete attacks do not break currently deployed systems.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 結果顯示前沿模型已能執行過去需人類專家與多年審查的專家級密碼分析。這強化了對密碼標準進行持續自動化紅隊測試的必要性，同時也強調這些具體攻擊並未破壞目前已部署的系統。
items_flat.quote: Despite HAWK having survived two rounds of expert human review over a period of two years, Mythos was able to improve the best-known attack on it in just 60 hours of work—effectively cutting its key strength in half.
items_flat.quote_zh: 儘管HAWK已在兩年內通過兩輪專家人工審查，Mythos仍能在僅60小時內改進其已知最佳攻擊——實質上將密鑰強度減半。

links.label: Anthropic Research – Discovering cryptographic weaknesses with Claude

items_flat.title_en: Grok 4.5 Now Available in GitHub Copilot
items_flat.summary_en: xAI announced that Grok 4.5 is rolling out in GitHub Copilot for Pro, Pro+, Max, Business and Enterprise users. It supports up to 500k-token context, text+image inputs and adjustable reasoning effort, selectable from the model picker in VS Code and other surfaces.
items_flat.summary_zh: xAI宣布Grok 4.5已在GitHub Copilot上線，供Pro、Pro+、Max、Business與Enterprise用戶使用。支援最高50萬token上下文、文字+影像輸入與可調整推理力度，可在VS Code等介面的模型選擇器中選用。
items_flat.analysis_en: The integration puts a competitively priced frontier coding model directly into the daily workflow of millions of developers, intensifying pressure on other model providers inside the Copilot ecosystem.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此整合將具價格競爭力的前沿編碼模型直接放入數百萬開發者的日常工作流，加劇Copilot生態系內其他模型供應商的壓力。
items_flat.quote: Grok 4.5, our smartest coding model, is now available in GitHub Copilot.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們最強的編碼模型Grok 4.5現已在GitHub Copilot中可用。

links.label: xAI Blog – Grok 4.5 in GitHub Copilot

items_flat.title_en: Elon Musk Teases Grok 4.6 (1.5T) Around August 7 and Grok 4.7 (2.1T) Weeks Later
items_flat.title_zh: Elon Musk預告Grok 4.6（1.5T）約8月7日推出、Grok 4.7（2.1T）數週後跟進
items_flat.summary_en: In an X post, Elon Musk stated that Grok 4.6 (1.5T model with significantly improved SFT & RL) is expected around August 7, followed a few weeks later by Grok 4.7 (2.1T model that is better in every way except slightly slower to serve, with even better token efficiency).
items_flat.summary_zh: Elon Musk在X貼文中表示，Grok 4.6（1.5T模型，SFT與RL大幅改進）預計約8月7日推出，數週後推出Grok 4.7（2.1T模型，各方面更優但服務稍慢，token效率更高）。
items_flat.analysis_en: The rapid cadence continues xAI’s monthly-foundation-model strategy and keeps competitive pressure on closed rivals. Exact performance gains, pricing and public availability details remain unconfirmed.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此快速節奏延續xAI每月基礎模型策略，並持續對封閉對手施加競爭壓力。確切效能提升、定價與公開可用性細節仍未確認。
items_flat.quote: Grok 4.6 releases around August 7. This will be the 1.5T model with significantly improved SFT & RL. Grok 4.7 will be the 2.1T model released a few weeks later.
items_flat.quote_zh: Grok 4.6約8月7日發布。這將是SFT與RL大幅改進的1.5T模型。Grok 4.7將是數週後發布的2.1T模型。

items_flat.title_en: Meta and BlackRock Announce $14B 1GW Data-Center Venture in El Paso for AI
items_flat.title_zh: Meta與BlackRock宣布在埃爾帕索成立140億美元、1GW AI資料中心合資事業
items_flat.summary_en: Meta and BlackRock announced a joint venture to develop and own a 1-gigawatt data-center campus in El Paso, Texas, with total development costs of approximately $14 billion. BlackRock funds will hold 80% ownership and Meta 20%; the facility is intended to support Meta’s AI training and inference needs.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta與BlackRock宣布成立合資事業，在德州埃爾帕索開發並擁有1吉瓦資料中心園區，總開發成本約140億美元。BlackRock基金持股80%、Meta持股20%；設施將支援Meta的AI訓練與推理需求。
items_flat.analysis_en: The deal underscores the capital intensity of frontier AI compute and Meta’s willingness to share ownership to accelerate capacity. Actual GPU deployment timelines and power-sourcing details will determine near-term impact.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此交易凸顯前沿AI算力的資本密集程度，以及Meta為加速產能而願意分享所有權。實際GPU部署時程與電力來源細節將決定近期影響。
items_flat.quote: Funds managed by BlackRock will own an 80% interest in the venture, while Meta will retain the remaining 20% ownership.
items_flat.quote_zh: BlackRock管理的基金將持有合資事業80%權益，Meta保留剩餘20%所有權。

items_flat.title_en: Meta Signs EU AI Act Code of Practice on Transparency of AI-Generated Content
items_flat.title_zh: Meta簽署歐盟AI法案「AI生成內容透明度實務守則」
items_flat.summary_en: Meta announced it is signing the EU AI Act Code of Practice on Transparency of AI-Generated Content. The move builds on Meta’s existing labeling work since 2024 and industry efforts such as C2PA, aiming for practical, interoperable identification of AI-generated material.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta宣布簽署歐盟AI法案「AI生成內容透明度實務守則」。此舉延續Meta自2024年以來的標籤工作與C2PA等產業努力，目標是實現實用且可互通的AI生成內容識別。
items_flat.analysis_en: Signing signals proactive regulatory alignment in Europe while Meta continues to emphasize that transparency must remain usable rather than purely compliance-driven. Implementation details and enforcement consistency across platforms will be the next test.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 簽署顯示Meta在歐洲採取主動監管對齊，同時持續強調透明度必須保持可用而非純粹合規導向。跨平台的實作細節與執法一致性將是下一項考驗。
items_flat.quote: Signing the EU AI Act Code of Practice on Transparency of AI-Generated Content... reflects our commitment to this principle.
items_flat.quote_zh: 簽署歐盟AI法《AI生成內容透明度實務守則》……反映我們對此原則的承諾。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Releases Open-Source Codex Security CLI
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI quietly released the open-source Codex Security CLI, which lets developers scan repositories, track findings across runs, verify fixes, and add security checks to CI/CD pipelines. It is available via npm as @openai/codex-security and is described as an early release seeking feedback.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI悄悄開源發布Codex Security CLI，開發者可用它掃描程式庫、跨執行追蹤發現、驗證修復，並將安全檢查加入CI/CD流程。可透過npm安裝@openai/codex-security，目前為早期版本並徵求回饋。
items_flat.analysis_en: Making the security agent’s CLI open and CI-friendly lowers the barrier for teams already using Codex-style agents to adopt continuous vulnerability scanning. Real-world false-positive rates and coverage against novel attack patterns will determine adoption speed.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 將安全代理的CLI開源並支援CI，降低已使用Codex類代理的團隊採用持續漏洞掃描的門檻。實際誤報率與對新攻擊模式的覆蓋範圍將決定採用速度。
items_flat.quote: We quietly released the open-source Codex Security CLI, but Hacker News found it before we had a chance to share it here... You can now use it to scan repositories, track findings across runs, verify fixes, and add security checks to CI/CD.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們悄悄發布了開源Codex Security CLI，但Hacker News在我們有機會在這裡分享之前就發現了……現在你可以用它掃描程式庫、跨執行追蹤發現、驗證修復，並將安全檢查加入CI/CD。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic Brings MCP 2026-07-28 Spec (Stateless Core) to Claude
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic將MCP 2026-07-28規格（無狀態核心）導入Claude
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic announced support for the MCP 2026-07-28 specification across Claude products. The update moves MCP to a stateless request/response core, hardens authorization to align with production OAuth 2.0/OIDC, and graduates official extensions for Apps and Tasks under a versioned framework.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic宣布Claude產品將支援MCP 2026-07-28規格。此次更新將MCP改為無狀態請求/回應核心、強化授權以對齊正式OAuth 2.0/OIDC，並在版本化框架下正式推出Apps與Tasks擴充。
items_flat.analysis_en: A stateless core removes a major scaling friction for MCP servers and should accelerate enterprise and edge deployments. Success will depend on how quickly the broader ecosystem of MCP servers and clients migrates to the new protocol version.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 無狀態核心消除MCP伺服器的主要擴展摩擦，應能加速企業與邊緣部署。成敗取決於更廣泛的MCP伺服器與客戶端生態系遷移至新協議版本的速度。
items_flat.quote: The latest spec moves MCP to a stateless core, while hardening authorization and graduating official extensions. This simplifies the experience of building MCP servers for Claude and scaling their usage as they grow in adoption.
items_flat.quote_zh: 最新規格將MCP改為無狀態核心，同時強化授權並正式推出官方擴充。這簡化了為Claude建構MCP伺服器的體驗，並隨著使用量成長更容易擴展。

links.label: Claude Blog – Bringing MCP 2026-07-28 to Claude

meta.summary_zh: Meta宣布簽署歐盟AI法案「AI生成內容透明度實務守則」。此舉延續Meta自2024年以來的標籤工作與C2PA等產業努力，目標是實現實用且可互通的AI生成內容識別。
meta.analysis_en: Signing signals proactive regulatory alignment in Europe while Meta continues to emphasize that transparency must remain usable rather than purely compliance-driven. Implementation details and enforcement consistency across platforms will be the next test.
meta.analysis_zh: 簽署顯示Meta在歐洲採取主動監管對齊，同時持續強調透明度必須保持可用而非純粹合規導向。跨平台的實作細節與執法一致性將是下一項考驗。
meta.quote: Signing the EU AI Act Code of Practice on Transparency of AI-Generated Content... reflects our commitment to this principle.
meta.quote_zh: 簽署歐盟AI法《AI生成內容透明度實務守則》……反映我們對此原則的承諾。

xai.title_en: xAI Introduces Build Mode for Creating Apps, Games and Dashboards with Grok
xai.title_zh: xAI推出Build Mode，可用Grok直接創建App、遊戲與儀表板
xai.summary_en: xAI announced Build Mode, now in early beta for SuperGrok Heavy subscribers on web, iOS and Android. Users describe an idea and Grok builds a working website, app, game or interactive dashboard live in the chat, then publishes it to a shareable link or custom domain.
xai.summary_zh: xAI宣布Build Mode，目前為SuperGrok Heavy訂閱用戶的早期測試版，支援網頁、iOS與Android。使用者描述想法後，Grok即時在對話中建立可用的網站、App、遊戲或互動儀表板，並可一鍵發布至可分享連結或自訂網域。
xai.analysis_en: This further collapses the distance between idea and functional software, keeping the entire creation loop inside Grok’s ecosystem. Real production robustness and long-term maintainability of the generated apps remain to be proven at scale.
xai.analysis_zh: 此功能進一步縮短「想法到可用軟體」的距離，並將整個創作迴路留在Grok生態系內。生成App的實際生產穩健性與長期可維護性仍有待大規模驗證。
xai.quote: Today we're introducing Build Mode, a new way to create with Grok. Tell Grok an idea, and it builds a working version live in your chat... When it's ready, publish it to a link anyone can open.
xai.quote_zh: 今天我們推出Build Mode，這是與Grok一起創作的新方式。告訴Grok一個想法，它就會在對話中即時建立可用版本……準備好後，發布到任何人都能打開的連結。

xai.title_en: Grok 4.5 Now Available in GitHub Copilot
xai.summary_en: xAI announced that Grok 4.5 is rolling out in GitHub Copilot for Pro, Pro+, Max, Business and Enterprise users. It supports up to 500k-token context, text+image inputs and adjustable reasoning effort, selectable from the model picker in VS Code and other surfaces.
xai.summary_zh: xAI宣布Grok 4.5已在GitHub Copilot上線，供Pro、Pro+、Max、Business與Enterprise用戶使用。支援最高50萬token上下文、文字+影像輸入與可調整推理力度，可在VS Code等介面的模型選擇器中選用。
xai.analysis_en: The integration puts a competitively priced frontier coding model directly into the daily workflow of millions of developers, intensifying pressure on other model providers inside the Copilot ecosystem.
xai.analysis_zh: 此整合將具價格競爭力的前沿編碼模型直接放入數百萬開發者的日常工作流，加劇Copilot生態系內其他模型供應商的壓力。
xai.quote: Grok 4.5, our smartest coding model, is now available in GitHub Copilot.
xai.quote_zh: 我們最強的編碼模型Grok 4.5現已在GitHub Copilot中可用。

links.label: xAI Blog – Grok 4.5 in GitHub Copilot

xai.title_en: Elon Musk Teases Grok 4.6 (1.5T) Around August 7 and Grok 4.7 (2.1T) Weeks Later
xai.title_zh: Elon Musk預告Grok 4.6（1.5T）約8月7日推出、Grok 4.7（2.1T）數週後跟進
xai.summary_en: In an X post, Elon Musk stated that Grok 4.6 (1.5T model with significantly improved SFT & RL) is expected around August 7, followed a few weeks later by Grok 4.7 (2.1T model that is better in every way except slightly slower to serve, with even better token efficiency).
xai.summary_zh: Elon Musk在X貼文中表示，Grok 4.6（1.5T模型，SFT與RL大幅改進）預計約8月7日推出，數週後推出Grok 4.7（2.1T模型，各方面更優但服務稍慢，token效率更高）。
xai.analysis_en: The rapid cadence continues xAI’s monthly-foundation-model strategy and keeps competitive pressure on closed rivals. Exact performance gains, pricing and public availability details remain unconfirmed.
xai.analysis_zh: 此快速節奏延續xAI每月基礎模型策略，並持續對封閉對手施加競爭壓力。確切效能提升、定價與公開可用性細節仍未確認。
xai.quote: Grok 4.6 releases around August 7. This will be the 1.5T model with significantly improved SFT & RL. Grok 4.7 will be the 2.1T model released a few weeks later.
xai.quote_zh: Grok 4.6約8月7日發布。這將是SFT與RL大幅改進的1.5T模型。Grok 4.7將是數週後發布的2.1T模型。

frontier_other.title_en: Over 1,100 AI Lab Staff Petition U.S. Government to Support Tools for Deliberately Pacing Frontier AI
frontier_other.title_zh: 超過1,100名AI實驗室員工聯署請願美國政府支持刻意調節前沿AI進度的工具
frontier_other.summary_en: More than 1,100 researchers and staff from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta and other labs signed the “Pacing the Frontier” petition calling on the U.S. government to support an international effort to develop technical and governance tools needed to deliberately pace the frontier of automated AI development. OpenAI and Anthropic officially endorsed the statement on X.
frontier_other.summary_zh: 來自OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、Meta等實驗室的超過1,100名研究與員工簽署「Pacing the Frontier」請願，呼籲美國政府支持國際合作，開發可刻意調節自動化AI研發前沿進度的技術與治理工具。OpenAI與Anthropic已在X正式表態支持。
frontier_other.analysis_en: The petition is notable for cross-lab consensus on the need for optional pacing mechanisms rather than an immediate pause. Whether governments build the requested tools, and how competitive pressures interact with any future coordination, remains the central uncertainty.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 此聯署值得注意的是跨實驗室對「可選調節機制」而非立即暫停的共識。政府是否真會建立所求工具，以及競爭壓力與未來協調如何互動，仍是核心不確定性。
frontier_other.quote: We request that the U.S. government support an international effort to develop the technical and governance tools needed to deliberately pace the frontier of automated AI development.
frontier_other.quote_zh: 我們請求美國政府支持一項國際努力，開發必要的技術與治理工具，以便刻意調節自動化AI研發的前沿進度。

frontier_other.title_en: NVIDIA-Led Open Secure AI Alliance Expands with 40+ Partners Including xAI, Microsoft and Hugging Face
frontier_other.title_zh: NVIDIA主導的Open Secure AI Alliance擴展至40+合作夥伴，包括xAI、Microsoft與Hugging Face
frontier_other.summary_en: NVIDIA’s Open Secure AI Alliance, launched 27 July and further promoted on 28 July, brings together more than 40 organizations (including SpaceXAI/xAI, Microsoft, Hugging Face, Mistral, IBM, Linux Foundation and others) to develop open tools and practices for securing AI models and agents.
frontier_other.summary_zh: NVIDIA於7月27日啟動、28日持續推廣的Open Secure AI Alliance，已集結超過40個組織（包括SpaceXAI/xAI、Microsoft、Hugging Face、Mistral、IBM、Linux Foundation等），共同開發保護AI模型與代理的開源工具與實踐。
frontier_other.analysis_en: The alliance frames open models and tooling as defensive assets in the wake of recent closed-model sandbox incidents. Its long-term effectiveness will depend on concrete shared artifacts and adoption beyond the founding members.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 此聯盟將開源模型與工具定位為近期封閉模型沙箱事件後的防禦性資產。長期成效取決於能否產出具體共享成果並擴大創始成員以外的採用。
frontier_other.quote: AI security advances when the industry builds in the open, together.
frontier_other.quote_zh: AI安全的進展，來自產業一起公開建構。

links.label: NVIDIA Blog – Open Secure AI Alliance

brief_en: Over 1,100 staff from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and Meta petitioned the US for tools to deliberately pace frontier AI. xAI launched Build Mode and added Grok 4.5 to GitHub Copilot while teasing 4.6/4.7. OpenAI open-sourced its Codex Security CLI. Anthropic shipped MCP 2026-07-28 to Claude and reported Claude Mythos cryptanalysis results. Meta advanced a $14B data-center JV and signed the EU AI Act transparency code.
brief_zh: 逾1,100名OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、Meta員工聯署請願美國支持刻意調節前沿AI工具。xAI推出Build Mode並將Grok 4.5加入GitHub Copilot，同時預告4.6/4.7。OpenAI開源Codex Security CLI。Anthropic將MCP 2026-07-28納入Claude並公布Mythos密碼分析成果。Meta推進140億美元資料中心合資並簽署歐盟AI透明守則。
